<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use ZipArchive;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class ArchiveController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Handle uploaded ZIP archives for document processing.
     * Extracts contents to a temporary processing directory.
     */
    public function upload(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'archive' => 'required|file|mimes:zip|max:51200',
            'project_id' => 'required|string|alpha_num',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('archive');
        $projectId = $request->input('project_id');
        
        // Store uploaded zip temporarily
        $tmpPath = $file->store('tmp/uploads');
        $fullTmpPath = storage_path('app/' . $tmpPath);
        
        $extractDir = storage_path('app/projects/' . $projectId . '/documents');
        
        if (!is_dir($extractDir)) {
            mkdir($extractDir, 0755, true);
        }

        $zip = new ZipArchive();
        $result = $zip->open($fullTmpPath);
        
        if ($result !== true) {
            unlink($fullTmpPath);
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Invalid archive file'], 422);
        }

        $extractedFiles = [];
        
        for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; $i++) {
            $entryName = $zip->getNameIndex($i);
            
            // Basic validation - skip hidden files and __MACOSX
            if (str_starts_with($entryName, '.') || str_starts_with($entryName, '__MACOSX')) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Skip directories
            if (str_ends_with($entryName, '/')) {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Validate file extension
            $allowedExtensions = ['pdf', 'doc', 'docx', 'txt', 'xlsx', 'csv'];
            $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($entryName, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
            if (!in_array($ext, $allowedExtensions)) {
                Log::warning('Skipped file with disallowed extension', ['file' => $entryName]);
                continue;
            }

            // Extract file to destination
            $destPath = $extractDir . '/' . $entryName;
            $destDir = dirname($destPath);
            
            if (!is_dir($destDir)) {
                mkdir($destDir, 0755, true);
            }
            
            // Read from zip and write to destination
            $stream = $zip->getStream($entryName);
            if ($stream === false) {
                continue;
            }
            
            $contents = stream_get_contents($stream);
            fclose($stream);
            
            file_put_contents($destPath, $contents);
            $extractedFiles[] = $entryName;
            
            Log::info('Extracted file', ['path' => $destPath, 'size' => strlen($contents)]);
        }

        $zip->close();
        unlink($fullTmpPath);

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Archive processed successfully',
            'files_extracted' => count($extractedFiles),
            'files' => $extractedFiles,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * List documents for a project
     */
    public function listDocuments(Request $request, string $projectId)
    {
        $dir = storage_path('app/projects/' . $projectId . '/documents');
        
        if (!is_dir($dir)) {
            return response()->json(['files' => []]);
        }

        $files = collect(scandir($dir))
            ->filter(fn($f) => !in_array($f, ['.', '..']))
            ->values();

        return response()->json(['files' => $files]);
    }
}

environment.description: Same Laravel 10.x application deployed on ECS Fargate with a hardened task definition. The container security context drops CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN from the effective capability set via the ECS task definition linuxParameters.capabilities.drop field. The container uses the php:8.2-fpm-alpine image with a non-root user (uid 1000). Storage is an EFS access point scoped to /projects with POSIX permissions enforcing uid 1000 ownership. The EFS access point has a root directory creation mode of 0750.
